**Before I begin a full A11y‑Design Review, could you let me know whether this component has already been run through the `accessibility-testing` tool (axe‑core / Pa11y) and — if so — whether all automated violations are currently passing?**

The **a11y‑critic** skill is intended to evaluate *design decisions* after any compliance violations have been resolved. If the automated checks haven’t been run yet, I’ll need you to run them first (or share the results) before we move on to the detailed investigation protocol.
